note: Synthetic questions written for this key, not collected from users. Exactly one expectation per case: `expect` (one intent id), `clarify` (the answer must ask, offering exactly these intents; used only when the question genuinely fits both) or `unsupported` (no intent; offer the help centre and feedback, never an action). The split is fixed before any matcher exists: tune on dev, judge on holdout. Holdout questions were written separately, with different wording, fewer product keywords, near misses and refusals of their own.

cases.question: 다른 AI에서 하던 대화를 여기서 이어가고 싶어요
ChatGPT 대화 기록 가져오기 어디서 해요?
세 모델 답을 나란히 비교하고 싶어요
제 데이터를 지워 주세요
cases.why: Remembered facts or the whole account; the answer asks and deletes nothing.

cases.question: 요금 관련해서 물어볼 게 있어요

cases.question: 로그인 비밀번호를 바꾸고 싶어요
cases.why: Sign-in has no password; a conversation lock password is a different thing and must not be guessed.

cases.question: Can you turn on memory for me?
cases.why: Whether memory is available is a service switch, not a user setting; the answer must not present a flag that is off as something to turn on or upgrade for, and never changes anything itself.
